# `authority.managed_section` family

Contract owner: AUTH-04 (#9431), `fleet-queue/src/work/authority.rs`.

`cases.json` holds a baseline body, the new section, update plans
(capability `unverified` or `{"verified": "<evidence>"}`, an optional
best-effort opt-in, the current body and the expected guarantee or
refusal) and PATCH-timeout reconciliations.
